jobs.description:
At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.
 

Qualifications:
 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.  

Skills:
 
 

• Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to influence and challenge constructively. 

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and business case development. 

• Strong affinity with digital reporting solutions and data analytics. 

• Experience with SAP and Power BI is preferred. 

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

What will you do?

• Lead the technical design, development and maintenance of a scalable and secure SaaS platform, making future-proof architectural decisions.
• Develop new features end-to-end, perform code reviews and continuously improve the platform's performance, reliability and maintainability.
• Contribute to the technical roadmap, evaluate architectural approaches and leverage innovative technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve both the software and development processes.

 

 

What are they looking for?

• You bring more than 10 years of experience in software engineering and have built up strong expertise in software architecture. You live in Belgium and are legally authorized to work here.
• You have strong expertise in .NET and C#, combined with experience in fornt-end development. You look beyond the code itself and know how to apply the right architectural principles and design patterns based on the platform's needs.
• You take initiative, enjoy solving challenges and feel at home in an entrepreneurial scale-up environment. You have excellent communication skills in English.

• Administration support : travels arrangements, expense claims, contacts, follow up holiday planning CCT members, Country Chair budget set up and monitoring, etc. 
 
• Communication support.. 
 
• Meetings planning, logistics preparations, minutes sharing with staff. 
 
• Support Social Investments plan and track execution. 
 
• Events preparation support : staff party, Family Day,... 
 
•   

You graduated recently or you already have a first work experience in a similar function.
 

You have excellent communication in English, French & Dutch (spoken/written).
 

You have strong administrative skills and excellent knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Job Description

As a Dispatch and Labelling Line Supervisor  you will have a varied and responsible role.

Under the guidance of the Dispatch Team Leader, you will ensure that labelling and packaging activities are carried out correctly, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards.

You will coordinate and guide the employees working on the production line, ensuring that every product meets the applicable quality and food safety requirements, as well as customer specifications.

You will gradually grow into your role. You will start by being responsible for one production line. As you gain experience, the aim is for you to be able to operate and supervise all lines.

The Line Supervisor has an operational, monitoring, and coordinating role on the shop floor. You will ensure that the daily production schedule is completed within the allocated time while maintaining the required quality standards.

 

A selection of your responsibilities:

• Allocate tasks, provide clear work instructions, and guide employees working in filling and labelling. You will also help train new colleagues.

• Set up, operate, and change over packaging and labelling machines. Troubleshoot minor technical issues independently and report defects to the technical department in a timely manner.

• Check labels: use the ERP system to assign the correct production order to the right line and ensure that every product receives the correct label.

• Perform and record quality checks, including metal detection, residual oxygen measurements, visual packaging inspections, seal integrity checks, and final product weight checks.

• Ensure that each customer's packaging, labelling, and palletising instructions are followed correctly. Check stacking patterns, quantities, and pallet labels.

• Monitor compliance with HACCP, IFS Food, Food Defense, and hygiene requirements, and report any deviations to the Quality Department or your supervisor.

 

Who are you?

 

• You have a good command of both Dutch and English, including speaking, understanding, and reading. French is an advantage!

• You have experience working as an operator in another company, preferably in the food industry.

• You are familiar with packaging and labelling machines, including operating, setting up, and changing them over.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are stress-resistant and comfortable working at a fast pace on machinery. Things can get quite busy at Kjure-Marblo!

• You have strong administrative skills and are confident using computers.

• As working in the food industry involves strict quality, hygiene, and safety requirements, gel nails, excessive make-up, eyelash extensions, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted. We prefer a natural look. :-)

• You are comfortable working in a cold environment, with temperatures around 4°C.

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!
